source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As the first battle round begins, if your army has a model with this ability, you may pick 1 objective marker.

For the rest of the battle, while any model with this ability is on the battlefield, a **Wound roll** of 1 may be re-rolled for attacks by friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** models against an enemy unit within range of the picked marker.

ability.when: start of the first battle round
ability.condition: your army includes at least 1 model with this ability

effect.while: at least 1 model with this ability is on the battlefield
effect.targetCondition: enemy unit within range of that objective marker
